prompts.Human:
Production sprite atlas for an original top-down 16-bit JRPG. Exactly 1024x1024 image divided into 8 equal columns and 8 equal rows. Each 128x128 cell contains ONE small full-body pixel character, centered, feet at same baseline, generous pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no shadows. Limited palette: dark walnut outlines, ochre skin, cream cloth, muted teal, burgundy, brass. Logical sprite about 20x28 pixels, crisp square pixel clusters enlarged 4x. No text, borders, numbers, grid or scenery.
Each row is one character. Row1: merchant man brown hair teal tunic brown apron satchel; row2: woman innkeeper burgundy dress cream apron; row3: hooded green scout archer; row4: elderly scholar cream coat book; row5: violet robed woman mage staff; row6: armored male guard teal cloak sword; row7: woman armored guard red hair spear; row8: rugged gold armored adventurer.
EXACT COLUMN SEMANTICS repeated for each row: col1 facing DOWN left foot forward, col2 facing DOWN right foot forward, col3 facing LEFT left foot forward, col4 facing LEFT right foot forward, col5 facing RIGHT left foot forward, col6 facing RIGHT right foot forward, col7 facing UP back view left foot forward, col8 facing UP back view right foot forward. Consistent identity, costume, size per row. Walk cycle must clearly alternate legs and arms. All sprites isolated on pure magenta.
prompts.Monster:
Production sprite atlas for an original top-down 16-bit JRPG matching walnut outlined sprites, muted teal, burgundy, ochre, cream, brass palette. Exactly 1024x1024, 8 equal columns by 8 equal rows. Every cell 128x128 with ONE complete isolated small pixel monster, generous pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background with NO shadows, no text or grid. Logical 22x26 pixel sprite enlarged 4x, sharp square clusters.
Row1 teal slime, row2 carnivorous red flower with leafy feet, row3 muscular green orc carrying wooden club, row4 vampire sorcerer in burgundy cape, row5 brown goblin with dagger, row6 purple bat wings open, row7 stone golem with teal rune, row8 pale teal ghost.
All eight rows use the EXACT same COLUMN order: down step A, down step B, left step A, left step B, right step A, right step B, UP back view step A, UP back view step B. Monsters look in indicated direction. Two frames alternate walking limbs; slime squashes versus extends, bat wings up versus down, ghost tail left versus right. Keep identity, scale, head size and foot baseline consistent. Must leave magenta gaps between ALL cells. Original designs, no UI, no scenery.
prompts.Terrain:
A game-ready modular terrain atlas in the exact same original 16-bit JRPG style: dark walnut pixel outlines, cream highlights, warm ochre stone, muted teal greens, restrained burgundy accents. Exactly 1024x1024, FOUR columns and FOUR rows, each 256x256 cell. No text or labels, no grid lines. Orthographic top-down with visible front wall faces, no isometric view. Crisp block pixels, logical 32x32 per cell enlarged 8x.
Cells in row-major order:
row1: seamless green grass ground texture filling entire cell; seamless tan packed earth road filling cell; seamless dark slate cave floor filling cell; seamless ochre carved stone ruin floor filling cell.
row2: dark volcanic rock floor with tiny glowing orange cracks filling cell (walkable cool rock); cave rock WALL face and top cap filling cell; sandstone ruin WALL with top edge filling cell; cream plaster timber WALL with top horizontal beam filling cell.
row3: repeating burgundy roof shingles filling cell; seamless deep teal WATER filling cell; stone stairs going UP isolated on pure magenta; stone stairs going DOWN isolated on pure magenta.
row4: compact leafy oak TREE isolated on pure magenta; small boulder isolated on pure magenta; front wooden open DOOR with transparent interior represented pure magenta, isolated on pure magenta; small blue glass timber-framed WINDOW isolated on pure magenta.
Textures touch ALL cell edges; isolated props fit with 16px margins inside their cell, no cast shadow. Do not draw a whole room, landscape or scene. This is a reusable tile asset sheet for manually assembling maps.
prompts.Props:
Original 16-bit top-down JRPG inventory and dungeon prop atlas matching warm walnut outlines, cream highlights, brass metals, muted teal, burgundy. Exactly 1024x1024, eight equal columns and four equal rows, 32 isolated objects. Pure MAGENTA background #ff00ff, no shadows, NO labels or grid. Each icon centered fully within its cell with ample margin. Crisp chunky hand pixel art, not painted, not 3D.
Row1 left to right: iron sword, steel axe, spear, wooden bow, wizard staff, wooden shield, leather armor, teal travel cloak.
Row2: red healing potion, blue potion, bread ration, brass lantern, old book, rolled scroll, golden ring, blue amulet.
Row3: ancient coin, chipped vase, ruby crystal, fossil bone, rope coil, merchant satchel, treasure chest closed, wooden crate.
Row4: scattered rubble stones, pile of skeleton bones (non graphic), fired clay pot, burning wall torch, floor spike trap, stone lever, scattered coins, magic cyan spell starburst.
Consistent pixel scale and orthographic top-down/front-face game perspective. No backgrounds baked into objects. This is a reusable modular sprite sheet.
